newsitem.title: USA: Steve Madden Thanksgiving weekend sales up.
newsitem.headline: Steve Madden Thanksgiving weekend sales up.

text.p: Steve Madden Ltd, which designs and markets women's fashion footwear, said Tuesday that same-store sales over the Thanksgiving weekend totaled $40,119, rising 42.9 percent versus the same period last year.
The company said it was proceeding with plans to open at least eight more stores in 1997, in new markets like Boston, Atlanta, New Jersey and Florida.
It will also try to strengthen its presence in New York, Chief Operating Officer Rhonda Brown said.
